notForYou.text: Flux is a powerful tool, but not a magic one. Here are the cases where it can't work miracles for you.

items.title: Your business idea is unclear
items.text: If your concept has never been tested on a real market, no tool will validate it for you.

items.title: You want to promote something illegal
items.text: Wayne Web is only for legal and legitimate activities. No exceptions.

items.title: You're looking for a magic wand

testimonials.quote: Before, my evenings vanished into Instagram and my website dated from 2017. Today Flux publishes for me, my storefront is beautiful and my customers book their bouquets online. I got my Sundays back.
The online appointment book changed everything: no more phone calls in the middle of a haircut. My clients book at night, I wake up to a full schedule. That is priceless.
I thought Google was for the big brands. Three weeks after publishing my storefront, a customer told me: “I found you while searching for a salon near me”. It gave me goosebumps.
Between the kitchen and deliveries, I didn't have a minute for digital. Flux prepares my posts and replies to my reviews. My restaurant lives online while I cook.
My storefront was online the same evening. The next day, first message from a couple about a wedding. The quote went out from my Flux space, signed within the week. I've never signed that fast.
I'm not a website guy, I'm an engine guy. Flux did the site, the SEO and the callback requests. My revenue followed. I recommend it to every tradesperson.

faqSection.text: Everything you want to know before diving in, no corporate speak. Still have a doubt? Write to us, a human will answer.

faq.a: You create your free account, answer a few questions about your business, and Flux builds your storefront in seconds. Then you activate the tools you need: appointments, posts, customer replies, local SEO… Everything is managed from a single space, built for hands-on people.

You start with 100 free credits, no credit card required. Then you use your credits based on your real needs: no forced subscription, no hidden fees. You move at your own pace, and you only pay for what moves your business forward.

faq.q: I'm not good with computers, is that a problem?
faq.a: Quite the opposite: Flux was built for you. If you can send a message, you can use Flux. No code, no jargon, no complicated settings — you answer simple questions and the tool does the technical work for you.

faq.q: How long until my site is online?
faq.a: Your storefront deploys in 1 second once it's ready. Building it takes a few minutes: the time to answer a few questions about your business. You can literally start tonight and be visible tomorrow morning.

faq.q: Can I manage my appointments and customers?
faq.a: Yes. Your customers book online on your storefront, you see your schedule in your space, and you can call a customer back in one click. Requests, messages and leads are centralized in one place — no more sticky notes and missed calls.

faq.q: Is there a commitment? Can I stop whenever I want?
faq.a: No commitment. You sign up without a credit card, you test with your free credits, and you stay only if Flux saves you time and brings you customers. Your data belongs to you, period.
We're developers, but above all we're by your side: a real team answers your messages within 24 business hours. Write to us via the contact form just below — we read everything and reply fast.
